_comment: Copy this file as fact_base_lite.json for the engagement and fill it in BEFORE assembling the HTML note (it is the note's number registry — every money/percentage figure the note prints must exist here with a source). Then run: python3 scripts/fact_base_lite_audit.py --note <note.html> --fact-base fact_base_lite.json — the gate fails on unregistered note numbers, registry numbers absent from the note, missing source fields, consensus-side facts without provider/vintage/statistic, temporal-order violations (when meta.t1_filing_timestamp is set), and placeholder tokens. meta.furniture whitelists benign repeated tokens the reverse check would otherwise flag (e.g. years, section numbers); prefer an empty list. Round 4 (reports 8/9): consensus facts carry consensus_statistic (mean | median | undisclosed); when meta.t1_filing_timestamp is set, every fact declares data_type pre_event_input | post_event_fact and post-event facts must have been retrieved at/after the filing time. The worked-example entries below use the family's canonical Alphabet Q3 2026 event; delete them and the _* keys when starting a real engagement. Round 5 (reports 10/11): entries may carry source_snapshot — the SHA-256 of the fetched source content recorded by scripts/source_snapshot.py --record; the lite audit's SNAPSHOT check (--snapshots source_snapshots.json, --strict-snapshots) verifies the registry <-> snapshot-archive linkage (internal consistency vs source truth). meta.mandate_context (fund_position + position_as_of) is optional but, once declared, must be complete whatever the audience — the position disclosure is unconditional.

meta.subject: Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ: GOOG / GOOGL)
meta.event: Q3 FY2026 earnings release + conference call

mandate_context._doc: OPTIONAL: declare when the fund holds any position in the covered name — then fund_position + position_as_of are required (unconditional disclosure, round 5 reports 10/11)
